title: Travelers? Check
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with the Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Exploring Widower's Nest

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Speak with the Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Go and speak to Loremaster Vraile. He needs you to do some more exploring in the Widower's Nest, something about working on a walkthrough.

Find Loremaster Vraile and talk to him about exploring the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

Good to see you again explorer. I am in need of your services once again.

Level range: 20–40
